items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: I'm a friend of Dave Wilborn.

ctx.x: Jimmy Hazelup. Oh, quite a few good players. Good and agile players.

J.R. Short, is that his name? Do you remember him? No. The trumpet player was named Blood. This may have been when you were in Philadelphia or something. Yeah. J.R. Short is in Detroit I think playing with the new McKinney's Cotton Pickers. He was a tuba player down here in the early 60s now, I don't know where you were then. That's a lot. Yeah, well, there were so many of those bands. He's with the new McKinney Cotton Pickers, isn't he? Yeah. I'm a friend of Dave Wilborn. Oh yeah? How on earth did you know him?…
